rule: Every number the app or pitch uses. value + unit + label + source + script.

nested_iou.label: Learned water map vs Sentinel-2 photos on 8 unseen days, speckle cut-off chosen without the scored day (nested)
nested_iou.ci_method: percentile bootstrap of the median over the 8 held-out days, 10,000 resamples, seed 0 (per-day scores fixed)

raw_iou.label: Same map with no speckle clean-up (8 unseen days)

old_iou_0_2.label: Old figure: 0.2 km2 cut-off picked after seeing these test days (leaky; do not quote as the score)

speckle_sensitivity.label: Median IoU on the 8 days for every cut-off (full sensitivity table)

baseline_rule_iou.label: Baseline: single HH threshold (-16.75 dB) on the same 8 days

baseline_rule_zone_iou.label: Baseline: HH threshold inside a 1 km water zone, same 8 days

baseline_otsu_iou.label: Baseline: Otsu threshold on HH: NOT computed (calibrated HH npz for Andijan is not in the repo; needs re-download)

recall.label: Share of photo water the radar map finds (median, 8 unseen days)

shuffled_control_iou.label: Same model trained on shuffled labels (must collapse)

icesat2_spearman.label: ICESat-2 ATL13 water level vs lake area, rank correlation

icesat2_n.label: ICESat-2 dates paired with an area

area_error_nested.label: Mean absolute area miss on the 8 unseen days (nested cut-off)

area_error_raw.label: Mean absolute area miss, no clean-up

wet_mud_bias.label: Over-count on the drying-shore days 26 Jul-12 Sep (radar minus photo, nested cut-off; error maps put it on the wet-mud shore)

lake_photo_23jun.label: Lake open water, Sentinel-2 photo 23 Jun 2026

lake_photo_19oct.label: Lake open water, Sentinel-2 photo 19 Oct 2026

always_wet_km2.label: Water on every one of 11 NISAR passes

dried_once_km2.label: Water on at least one pass but not all (ever minus every pass)

forecast_dec.label: Dec 2026 lake area forecast
forecast_dec.band: 8 in 10 (10th-90th percentile of its own walk-forward misses)

typical_dec.label: Typical December: mean of the 3 clear Decembers in the 2017-2025 photo record

dec_anomaly.label: Dec forecast minus typical December (typical lies inside the 8-in-10 band: below normal, not a significant anomaly)

persistence_mae_30d.label: Persistence (same as last month) miss, 30 days ahead

winter_cloud.label: Sentinel-2 winter (Dec-Mar 2025) photos of the reservoir lost to cloud [unverified: no data file in repo; quoted from docs/state/handoff.md]

aral_1985_km2.label: Aral box open water, Landsat summer 1985 (44.7 % of pixels filled from 1986)

aral_2026_km2.label: Aral box open water, Landsat/Sentinel summer 2026

aral_loss_pct.label: Open water lost in the Aral box, 1985 to 2026
aral_loss_pct.source: derived from the two numbers above

nisar_start_andijan.label: First public NISAR GCOV pass over Andijan (bbox 72.9,40.6,73.3,40.9)

nisar_start_global.label: First provisional NISAR GCOV granule anywhere

nisar_granules_provisional.label: NISAR GCOV provisional granules in CMR on 2026-11-15

nisar_granules_validated.label: NISAR GCOV validated (V1) granules in CMR on 2026-11-15
